overview: The true identity of Citrus is actually Ponta!? The entire stadium is excited about the revival of the Bottle King. However, knowing Ponta as a goofy person, Cota still thinks he is just joking... Meanwhile, Haku's new third personality emerges!! That is the Haku who blindly believes in Citrus. In order to be recognized by Citrus, Haku challenges Cota to a duel! Somehow, he has two Bottlemen in hand?? Is... is that even possible??

title: Fizzy Fair Play and Triple Impact!
overview: Haku's Bottlemen has combined!! The two Bottlemen upgrade into one cool Bottleman! Is that even possible!? Shiman comes to Cota's side to assist him, and together they counter Haku by firing three shots at the same time!! As they shoot toward each other fiercely, Haku and Shiman's conversation heats up over Cota?? In addition, Citrus says that he will remake the Bottle Battle! Which way of Bottle Battle would Cota choose...!?

title: Blow, Cap Storm! Leo vs. Ryo!
overview: Leo enters the burst state by himself, and has been swallowed by madness! He blew Tsubasa away and won the victory! Ryo appears there, saying “I'm here to stop you!” …However, the battle breaks off due to Haku's interference! Haku and Citrus announce that they are launching a new third team! The match becomes a battle between three factions!? Team Citrus shows overwhelming strength and jumps to the top at once. The chaotic Bottle Battle is about to enter the second match!!

title: The Raging Bull Stops
overview: "I will quit Bottle Battling." Cota is shocked by Tsubasa's shocking retirement announcement! Tsubasa quietly talks about his young age…. He used to long for becoming a strong Bottle King like Io Hocari…. Cota asks Tsubasa, whose faith has wavered and lost his goal, to have another Bottle Battle once again. A fair and square power match between Colamaru Energy DX and Raidbrave DX! A dream Bottle Battle between the master and the disciple starts now!

title: Citrus` Dragogina DX Appears!
overview: The final match where the future of Bottle Battle depends on has finally started! The strengths of Haku and Citrus are overwhelming! “We'll protect our Bottle Battle!” says Ryo. In order to defeat the Bottle King Citrus, the champions Tsubasa and Leo join forces!? The strongest tag that crosses the boundaries of teams rampages! Don't miss the hot Bottle Battle where deadly shots fly one after another! Finally, Citrus' beloved unit, Dragogina DX, has descended after a long time!

title: The Conclusion!? Cota vs. Kurenai Haku!
overview: The Bottle Battle that Haku chose is Push Bottle! Moreover, the bottle target is a specialized version! It can't be moved by Cota's light shots!? Haku's Royal Gryphon DX bursts into flames of jealousy!! However, Cota counterattacks without just being pushed around!! The Strongest of the Strongest, Citrus and Dragogina DX! Ryo stands in their way. Aquasports DX devours with full speed rapid fire!!

title: The Undisputed King
overview: The Bottle King Citrus fell down mysteriously!? The venue is agitated, but he gets up and continues the Bottle Battle immediately! The attacks fired one after another from Dragogina DX are calm and accurate. Ryo is at the mercy of the four simultaneous vertical shots. He is chased by the shots without a chance!! Continuing to dodge with a narrow escape, Ryo boldly stands up! In addition, Cota also joins the fight! What would happen to the future of Bottle Battles~!?

title: Vital Sync, The Hidden Truth!
overview: Citrus's consciousness has been jacked by an AI!? "Why?" Ryo questions. The AI in the form of Citrus says it will explain in a Bottle Battle. The shots fired from accurate readings make Ryo and Machiko anxious! Although the AI was created for humanity, it denies the emotions that humans have. Ryo and the others shudder at the terrifying plan being told to them! The truth about Vital Sync is finally revealed!?
